name: @levonis/svc-ads
description: levonis-ads — the only Worker that talks to an advertising platform: a provider registry behind one adapter interface (Meta Conversions API on the Meta graph/Marketing endpoint, Google Ads offline conversions, TikTok events, Snapchat conversions, plus noop), a SANDBOX implementation used whenever a provider's secret NAME is not configured, consent-gated identifiers, the seeded event -> provider-event map, per-provider and global kill switches, an idempotent deliveries table keyed (event_id, provider), retry/backoff with dead-letter rows, per-provider timeouts and circuit breakers.
